finds.name: Glowfruit
finds.description: Soft fruit that glows faintly at dusk. Sweet, filling and easy to pick.

finds.name: Ember Tubers
finds.description: Warm-skinned roots dug from loose soil. Heavy, starchy and bland.

finds.name: Veilcaps
finds.description: Pale fungus that grows in damp shade. Thin fare, but its spores dull pain.

finds.name: Reedgrain
finds.description: Seed heads from marsh reeds. They dry well and grind into flour.

finds.name: Bitterleaf
finds.description: A sharp herb few enjoy eating. Steeped, it settles fevers.

finds.name: Sweetpods
finds.description: Sugary vine pods the crew craves. They ferment if left in the sun.

finds.name: Shellbacks
finds.description: Slow, hard-shelled grazers that cluster on warm stones. Rich meat, but they cannot be farmed.

finds.name: Silkreed
finds.description: Fine, glossy fibre that weaves into soft cloth.

finds.name: Barkweave
finds.description: Stringy bark that braids into strong rope.

finds.name: Spinegrass
finds.description: Tough barbed grass. It cuts hands but makes fine netting.

finds.name: Glassvine
finds.description: A translucent vine that carries light along its length.

finds.name: Basalt
finds.description: Dense dark stone that splits into clean blocks.

finds.name: Limestone
finds.description: Soft pale stone. Burned, it makes lime for plaster.

finds.name: Glassrock
finds.description: Black volcanic glass that flakes to razor edges.

finds.name: Sunstone
finds.description: Amber stone that holds the day's heat long after dark.

finds.name: Verdigris Copper
finds.description: Green-streaked copper ore, soft and conductive.

finds.name: Rust Iron
finds.description: Red bog iron. Plentiful, and it smelts into tough tools.

finds.name: Cobalt Glass
finds.description: Blue crystalline ore that bends light like a lens.

finds.name: Singing Quartz
finds.description: Quartz that hums when struck, at a pitch no one can explain.

finds.name: Glyph Stones
finds.description: Standing stones carved with dense, repeating script.

finds.name: Dormant Engine
finds.description: A buried machine, cold but intact, older than any record.

finds.name: Crystal Archive
finds.description: Lattices of crystal that store patterns of light.
